note: Gate 1c (spec 5.3). Every stone shape GLASS emits, plus the deliberately malformed twins. 'decoder' is what OUR reference decoder must do; 'indexer' is what ZRunes' own indexer must conclude. Where they differ ours is stricter on purpose: a cenotaph on a head spend burns the pool's entire GLASS and cannot be undone.

vectors.name: buy-canonical
vectors.why: the exact shape op.rs stone_buy emits: pointer at the trader, one edict naming what stays with the pool

vectors.name: sell-canonical
vectors.why: the exact shape op.rs stone_sell emits

vectors.name: tag-105-reserved-ignored
vectors.why: spec 5.3: tag 105 was MIN_OUT in draft 0.2, is never emitted, and must be ignored if seen

vectors.name: tag-101-twice
vectors.why: spec 5.3: a repeated GLASS tag is a breach on a head spend; ZRunes ignores unknown odd tags so the INDEXER still reads it, and ours must be the stricter one

vectors.name: tag-101-and-103
vectors.why: two side markers on one transaction: a well-formed stone the RULE must refuse, not the decoder

vectors.name: even-unknown-tag-26
vectors.why: an even tag the spec does not define makes the stone MALFORMED to a ZRunes indexer, which burns every input balance; on a head spend that is the pool's entire GLASS

vectors.name: even-unknown-tag-30
vectors.why: same, with a different even tag and a value that is not 1

vectors.name: descending-tags
vectors.why: tags must ascend; this is the bug that would have burned the pool on its first trade

vectors.name: edict-amount-zero
vectors.why: amount 0 means ALL REMAINING in ZRunes: well formed, and never valid for a trade

vectors.name: edict-past-last-output
vectors.why: an edict naming an output that does not exist is malformed to an indexer; the decoder cannot see the output count, so allocation is what must refuse

vectors.name: pointer-past-last-output
vectors.why: same for the pointer: caught at allocation, not at decode

vectors.name: truncated-varint
vectors.why: a varint that runs off the end of the payload

vectors.name: not-op14
vectors.why: OP_RETURN OP_1, not OP_14: not a ZRunestone at all

vectors.name: oversize-payload
vectors.why: the push length claims 80 bytes; the network relays at most 79 and the payload does not match it
